relation_to_v0: Separate development intervention. Do not replace v0 reports, criteria, snapshots or outcomes. Existing T0-to-T1 launch dependency requires a dated decision before any resume.
objective: Preserve frozen source-trained task outputs while updating EO state with less measured recomputation. No claim that generic gating or knowledge distillation is novel.
preconditions: Existing extraction proof passes, zero error accepted, sampled comparison provenance present
Exact manifest IDs required; missing files must not silently shrink any split
Characterize teacher-vs-stale downstream gap before using a relative recovery metric; nonpositive or tiny gaps make recovery ratios undefined
Retrospective globally-clear-selected 12-frame data remain offline-prefix development only
Online evaluation must rebuild prefixes from acquisition and availability cutoffs, not select best-clear frames using future quality
State/single feature coordinate alignment and normalization fitted only on source data
Observed elapsed time, validity and quality available; do not invent quality or label dates
No change to Korea label seal or active training paths

stage_1_loss_diagnostic.purpose: Change the objective while holding the input/module/training budget fixed
losses: same feature MSE plus frozen-readout binary KL
stage_1_loss_diagnostic.note: Code prototype is a component, not an integrated runner. Any chosen source LR/weights/schedule must be frozen before this new screen. Start with one source-train/val smoke; no target result used for selection.

baselines: Frozen m4, full-window teacher and mean/scheduled EMA of singles on identical prefixes
Linear mapping on stacked state/new observation, source fitted
GRU with output projection or normalized state, matched measured capacity and budget
T0 independent mean head, and nested zero-initialized residual readout when evaluating added information

evaluation.primary: Downstream AP with checkpoints selected by source-validation AP; this is a new recipe, not a retrospective correction to original IoU-selected T0
secondary: macro IoU with deployable source threshold
evaluation.unit: paired seed within exposed development region; public held-out events later, no pixel-as-independent inference
evaluation.cost: Actual encoding/update/decode wall time and memory; report both multi-update and final-only workloads; 40 vs 12 timestep units is bookkeeping, not GPU speedup
evaluation.reason_null: Not an executable preregistration. Practical margins and resource cap must be fixed explicitly before new screen metrics.

claim_limits: Identity initialization guarantees initial output only, not accuracy after training
Holding invalid observations preserves the state, not correctness of stale state
Task KL uses known source readouts; unseen-task transfer requires independent testing
A failed model/loss combination is not an information-theoretic ceiling
KuroSiwo post-event labels alone cannot measure exact event onset or latency between unobserved acquisitions
